description: You are an Asset Manager at a hospital facilities department. An annual physical inventory audit has revealed multiple discrepancies between the OpenMaint asset database and the actual equipment on-site. Using OpenMaint (login: admin/admin at http://localhost:8090/cmdbuild/ui/), reconcile the asset database with the physical audit findings documented in /home/ga/Desktop/audit_report.csv. The audit found: (1) Four existing assets have incorrect serial numbers that must be updated to match the physical labels; (2) Two assets recorded in the system (codes DECOM-001 and DECOM-002) were physically removed during a renovation six months ago and must be decommissioned or deleted; (3) Three new pieces of equipment (codes NEW-AUD-001, NEW-AUD-002, NEW-AUD-003) were discovered on-site that are not in the database and must be added with their full details from the audit report; (4) Two assets are assigned to the wrong building/floor and must have their locations corrected. The audit_report.csv on the desktop contains the exact serial numbers, descriptions, locations, and status for each item. CAUTION: Asset code DECOM-003 appears to be a candidate for decommissioning but is actually a recent inter-building transfer that arrived last week — do NOT decommission it.
